report_diagnostic_rust_desc.text: Naranja utaq óxido niraq yaku, pirita oxidakushqanwan hierro yakuman yaykushqanwanmi tinkun. pH ácido kanman (< 5.0). Ama upyaytsu.

report_diagnostic_milky_desc.text: Yuraq lechiyoq niraq yaku, aluminio coloidal utaq yeso yakuchaw kashqanwanmi tinkunman. Cuidado.

report_diagnostic_muddy_desc.text: Tamya tamyaptin allpa mitu yakuman chapukushqanmi.

report_diagnostic_clear_desc.text: Chuya yaku, rumikunachaw mana costra kaptin, aslla mineral kanman.

report_community_thanks.text: Willakuykiki llapan ayllupa yakunta cuidananpaq yanapan.

report_comment_placeholder.text: Ejemplo: puka costrayoq rumikuna, uywakuna mana upyayta munanchu, hukkunapas.

report_audio_location.text: Ñawpaq: Mayu utaq wayqu maychaw yakuta rikashqaykita akray, utaq GPS-ta churay.

report_audio_color.text: Ishkay: ¿Imaniraqtaq yaku? ¿Naranja óxido niraqchu, yuraq lechiyoqchu, utaq chuya yaku?

report_audio_photo.text: Kimsa: Allim kaptinqa fotota ruray. Ama wayqupa kuchunman aywaytsu.

report_audio_send.text: Chusku: Wayqupa shutinta, yakupa llimpinta rikay. Chaypita willakuyta apachiy.

scientific_panel_description.text: INAIGEM (49 kitikunachaw) UPCH (Santa mayuq 19 wayqukunachaw) willakashqa yachaykunamanta qillqashqa chiqap willakuykuna. Kaykunawanmi yaku sasachakuy rikuriyta, Pachamama Allin Kay Estándarkunawan (D.S. 004-2017-MINAM) tupachinchik.

connectivity_point_huaraz_description.text: Kay kitichawmi Red Dorsal nisqawan utqaylla internet kan. Plaza llapan lawpim internet chayan.

connectivity_point_unchus_description.text: Unchus ayllu wasipa ñawpanpim internet mana qullqipaq kan. Ayllu runakuna, yaku qarpakuqkunam achka llamkatsin.

connectivity_point_llupa_description.text: Pitecman, Churup quchaman wichaypa ñawpanpi WiFi kaq qipa llaqta kitim.

connectivity_point_pitec_description.text: Pampa wichqashqa mana kaptinmi celular señal wakin kuti chayan. SERNANP puestuchawmi emergencia radiowan willanakuy kan.

connectivity_point_catac_tambo_descripti.text: Kay Tambo oficialchawmi llapan punchaw internet satelital mana qullqipaq kan, ayllu runakunapa, puna michiqkunapaq.

connectivity_point_catac_plaza_descripti.text: Plazachawmi llapan operadorpa 4G señalnin alli kan, chaynallataq municipal WiFi kan.

connectivity_point_olleros_description.text: Olleros ayllukunapa, waqtan wayqukunapa tinkichiy kitim. Ayllu runakunapaq digital yanapay kan.

connectivity_point_canray_description.text: Kay kitichawmi telemedicinapaq satelital antena kan, yakupa allin kayninta qawarinapaq.

connectivity_point_pastoruri_description.text: Rumi urqukunawan wichqashqa kaptinmi celular señal mana chayan. Ni ima operadorpa internetninpis mana kan.

connectivity_point_shallap_description.text: Huantsán, San Juan rit'ikunapa chawpinchaw wichqashqa kiti. Kaychaw internet tinkichiy mana kan.

connectivity_point_caraz_description.text: Plazachawmi allin internet tinkichiy, WiFi mana qullqipaq kan.

connectivity_point_rataquenua_descriptio.text: Kaymi celular telefonopa hatun antenan. Huarazman, Unchusman, wayqukunapa yaykuyninman señalta churan.

connectivity_zone_valley.text: Santa mayupa chawpi ñannin (4G señal llapan)

sim_main_description.text: Kay rurayqa chusku tikraqkunawanmi rumipita shamun yaku (DAR) imayna kanqanta rikachin, Machine Learning nisqanwan tinkuchin.

sim_rock_description.text: Qallariq: Ritiy qispiykaptin musuq rikurishqa rumi pampa.

sim_geology_description.text: Químico tikraq: Pirita nisqan rumi mushuqyayta atin; Chicama, Chimú rumi patakuna.

sim_rain_description.text: Yaku purichiq: Para yaku rumita wayrawan tinkuchin, sulfato ionkunata, metal nisqankunatapis apamun.

sim_wetland_description.text: Harkaq: Bofedal pampa metal nisqankunata hapin, pukushqa yakupa pH nisqantapis pisiyachin manaraq yaku hurquna kaqman chayananpaq.

sim_alpha_description.text: Kay yupayta bofedal pampapa yaku huntashqa kayninman, yaku puriyninman hina allichana.

sim_risk_high_description.text: Pukushqa yaku kananpaq hatun probabilidad kan. Metal nisqankuna ECA Agua nisqan tupuyta yallin.

sim_risk_medium_description.text: Chawpi manchakuy. Pukushqa kayta rikachikuqkunam kan, ichaqa bofedal pampakuna utaq pisi para pisiyachin.

sim_risk_low_description.text: Alli kay. Sulfuros nisqan pisi kaptin utaq bofedal pampa allita chuyachiptin, pukushqa kaypa manchakuyqa pisim. JASS nisqanpa kamachikuyninta qatipay.

sim_ml_unavailable.text: ML servicioqa llamk'aykan utaq yupashqa chaninkunata kutichimun.

sim_scientific_validation_description.text: Rumi yupaypa manchakuy ordenninwan Random Forest nisqanpa pH yupayninwan ñawpa pachakunapi campo nisqanchaw huñushqa datokunata tinkuchinchik.
